notes.title: New Demo Live for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello elementalists! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Play the beginning of the game in our new demo[/b][/h3][p]We’re taking part in Steam Next Fest, and to celebrate, we’ve prepared a brand-new demo! This version includes the very beginning of the game and the first biome, the volcano, but you’ll also be able to explore a few other biomes.[/p][p]And good news: [b]your save file from the demo will carry over to the final release!

[/b]We hope you enjoy taking your first steps in [b]Elementallis[/b]! Feel free to [url="https://discord.gg/elementallis"]join our Discord[/url] and tell us about your thoughts on the demo.

Also don't forget to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/"]wishlist Elementallis[/url] so you don't miss the release![/p]

notes.title: New Trailer Premiere @ Top Hat Studios Showcase
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're happy to announce that we're debuting a brand new trailer as part of our participation in the Top Hat Studios Showcase. We know that development has been a little slow, but we're happy to announce that we are finally expecting a release this year. We are currently in the process of translating all of our text and finishing up QA. We will have more news soon - in the meantime, we hope you enjoy the trailer!

notes.title: Elementallis NEW demo!
notes.notes:
Elementallis new demo features the first full area of the game, Rogentia, the volcano biome 🔥 

Meet the dwarfs and return the lava to their village, get through the mines while facing new fire type enemies and obtain items and upgrades along the way! The demo is set a bit after the tutorial in the game and the beginning of your journey, since we didn't want to make it super long. It's an almost full biome with its town, area and temple.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/]Don't forget to add Elementallis to your wishlist! [/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/

Also, [url=https://discord.gg/elementallis]join our Discord server[/url]. We'd love to hear your feedback! ^^
